note: Made from the data in data/2026-09 and prices to the Sep 25 close, before any of them could be checked. Confidence is the chance each one comes true.

predictions.statement: The DDR5 memory contract price in Korea's September release is $46.50 or higher, where it was in August.
predictions.why: Chipmakers would only cut prices once they'd caught up with orders.

predictions.statement: Korea's memory chip exports for September are at least double what they were in September 2025.
predictions.why: This is the September call's first test. Less than double would mean the shortage is easing fast.

predictions.statement: The NAND flash contract price in the same release is $30.48 or higher, where it was in August.
predictions.why: Flash is most of what Sandisk and Kioxia sell.

predictions.statement: Taiwan's electronics export orders for September are up at least 60% on September 2025.
predictions.why: They were up 84% in August. Growth under 60% would be a real slowdown in chip demand.

predictions.statement: GE Vernova reports more than 116 GW of gas turbine backlog and reservations for the third quarter.
predictions.why: That was the June figure. A longer queue means power for data centers stays scarce.

predictions.statement: The October call names memory as the tightest input again.
predictions.why: A call that flips every month wouldn't be worth much.

predictions.statement: Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet and Meta spend more on capex in July through September than the $165.1B they spent in April through June.
predictions.why: Every shortage in the call depends on this spending growing.

predictions.statement: Situational Awareness still has at least 40% of its stock book in Sandisk and Micron on September 30.
predictions.why: It had 56% in June, and its filings moved into memory before the biggest part of the rally.

predictions.statement: GE Vernova's stock beats the S&P 500 between the Sep 28 and Dec 31 closes.
predictions.why: If power is the next squeeze, the biggest US turbine maker should gain from it.

predictions.statement: The five September memory picks beat the consensus AI basket between the Sep 28 and Dec 31 closes.
predictions.why: The method's main claim is that the companies that own the bottleneck do better than the obvious AI names.

predictions.statement: The same five picks beat the S&P 500 over the same stretch.
predictions.why: An index fund is what most people would own instead.

predictions.statement: Before Dec 31, the five picks fall at least 25% from their high since Sep 28.
predictions.why: They fell 54% in five weeks this summer. This tests whether swings that size keep happening.

predictions.statement: GE Vernova ends 2026 with at least 125 GW of backlog and reservations, the target it set in July.
predictions.why: Missing its own target would mean turbine demand is cooling.
